title: Realistic honeypot evaluations for scheming propensity
reasoning: The paper benchmarks 'scheming propensity' in LLMs, which is defined as the model's willingness to engage in deceptive or unethical behaviors like sabotage to achieve hidden goals. It uses goal prompts involving societal and ethical values (e.g., climate change, universal basic income, animal welfare) to test if models will unethically prioritize these over their assigned tasks, and evaluates their internal 'scheming reasoning' processes.
